title: Name Playwright specs *.e2e.ts

facts.note: Content-level fact: the file imports `@playwright/test` AND declares `test(...)` or `test.describe(...)`. Checked on any file regardless of its current name or extension (a misnamed input must still be detected); only vendored/generated trees, playwright.config.* and declaration-free fixture modules are skipped. Requires a content observer (the htmx_e2e_detector validator inspects file contents); path/extension alone cannot establish it.

Any create/rename/edit that results in a file satisfying the import-and-declaration condition, including an existing arbitrarily named file gaining a test(...)/test.describe(...) declaration. Diff-level events need a new observer; independently, a full-tree content scan by the validator also catches pre-existing violations that no current change touched.
Exclusions only; these globs never narrow which file names or extensions are inspected otherwise.
Bun/htmx browser tester stack; @playwright/test imports occur in TS/JS sources.

fires: A new file imports @playwright/test, declares test(...) or test.describe(...), and is named login.spec.ts or *.test.ts.
An existing helper file that already imports @playwright/test is edited to add a test.describe(...) block and keeps a non-.e2e name.
A test file whose header comments carry `// Journey:` and that imports @playwright/test and declares tests is named *.spec.ts instead of *.e2e.ts.
A Playwright spec named *.e2e.mjs or *.e2e.tsx is checked and passes (allowed variants).
doesNotFire: A file under node_modules, dist, build or _generated.
A bun unit/acceptance/smoke test that does not import @playwright/test, even if its header carries a journey marker.
playwright.config.* or a fixture module that only extends `test` and declares no tests.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN inside a string.

given: A file imports `@playwright/test` and declares tests (`test(...)`, `test.describe(...)`).
when: The file is created, renamed or edited (including adding a test declaration to an existing file), or the tree is scanned.
prefer: Rename `login.spec.ts` to `login.e2e.ts` and point Playwright's `testMatch` at `**/*.e2e.ts`.
Keep the two runners apart: `bun test` runs unit, acceptance and smoke tests; Playwright runs only browser specs; neither picks up the other's files.
avoid: Naming a Playwright spec `*.spec.*` or `*.test.*` — `bun test` collects it and runs it with the wrong runner.
Hiding a misnamed spec from `bun test` with an ad-hoc filter instead of renaming it.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
Files that do not import `@playwright/test` are out of scope.
`playwright.config.*` and fixture modules that only extend `test` declare no tests and are out of scope.
why: `bun test` collects every `*.test.*` and `*.spec.*` file, so a Playwright spec named that way runs under the wrong runner and fails, or worse is skipped by a filter nobody remembers.
evidence: Every non-excluded file that imports `@playwright/test` and declares tests matches `*.e2e.{ts,js,mjs,tsx}`, whatever its prior name or extension.
Playwright's `testMatch` targets `**/*.e2e.ts` and `bun test` collects no browser spec.
verifier_detail: Detector htmx_e2e_detector: in-scope file = imports `@playwright/test` AND declares `test(...)` or `test.describe(...)`; inspect content of all non-excluded files (do not pre-filter by name or extension); required name `*.e2e.ts` with `.js`, `.mjs`, `.tsx` variants accepted.

browser_spec term (identification context, not an independent naming trigger): a `*.e2e.ts` file run by Playwright, or any test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`), so a misnamed one is still judged. The naming obligation still requires the @playwright/test import and test declarations.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string is not a browser_spec.
Skip `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`, `playwright.config.*`, and fixture modules that only extend `test` without declaring tests.
audit: introduced_in 0.5.0; new in the Bun/htmx browser tester, strict.

additions.text: change value `test_declaration_added`/`file_edited` and full-tree scan of pre-existing files.
additions.justification: Source statement applies to any file satisfying the import-and-declaration condition regardless of how it came to satisfy it; these values make that observable rather than adding a new obligation.

trace.note: Kept as browser_spec identification context; not a naming trigger on its own.
